knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Leftover protein blunts disinfection and sterilisation, so cleaning has to come first. Option B gives that reason.
Enzyme cleaners do not disinfect, and they need rinsing off. The remaining options are at odds with the guideline.
The guideline requires dry, clean storage, protection from sharp objects and an intact wrap. The other options break those conditions.

practicalCriteria: Learner describes the authorised steps in the facility's procedure for a given item, without carrying out any reprocessing unless authorised.
Learner examines a sealed pack and spots any damage or moisture that rules it out.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor record of the procedure read-back
stopWorkCriteria: Reprocessing is requested and the learner is not authorised in writing
A pack is damaged, wet or unlabelled
A single-use device is requested for reprocessing
An item may carry prions or an unknown agent
